title: Oasis | KEY.co
description_expanded: The spacious open floor plan welcomes you with a renovated kitchen, an adjacent dining area, a comfortable living room, a full bathroom, and a rear screened-in porch that spans the entire length of the home. The kitchen features modern stainless steel appliances, including a large double-door fridge, and a generously sized breakfast bar with seating for four additional guests. The dining area, with its two benches, can easily accommodate six to eight people. In the living room, you'll find two plush slipcovered sofas, a club chair, and a large mounted flat-screen TV equipped with a soundbar. For added convenience, the sofa doubles as a queen sleeper to accommodate two more guests. Adjacent to the living room, a fully renovated bathroom offers a sleek single vanity and a glass-enclosed shower with a refreshing rain head. Venturing to the second floor, you'll find three tastefully appointed bedrooms and yet another incredible porch to enjoy. The first bedroom is a generously sized king master suite complete with an ensuite bathroom and access to the shared screened porch. The master bedroom offers ample space, storage options, a flat-screen smart TV, and a large renovated private bathroom featuring a single vanity and a glass-enclosed walk-in shower with a relaxing rain shower head. The screened porch is an oasis with a cozy bed swing and a spacious sectional lounger sofa, offering the perfect retreat for an afternoon immersed in a book or a delightful spot for an evening glass of wine.
